The Brain Unclogger

Dump everything currently occupying your brain.

What it does

You dump everything. It separates it into five piles:

  • Do
  • Decide
  • Delegate
  • Remember
  • Ignore

The point is to turn mental clutter into something you can act on. Not to turn every thought into another task.

When to use it

  • When your brain is full and you can't tell what's urgent anymore.
  • Before you try to plan the week.
  • When ideas are living in 14 tabs, three Notes files and a Slack message to yourself.

What to give it

  • Everything. Unedited. Half-sentences are fine.
  • Voice-to-text is fine. It doesn't need to be organized. That's its job.

What you get back

  • Your brain dump sorted into do, decide, delegate, remember and ignore.
  • The decisions pulled out on their own.
  • An ignore pile you're allowed to actually ignore.

How to use this in Claude

  1. Download the .zip. Don’t unzip it.
  2. In the Claude app, open Settings and find Skills.
  3. Upload the .zip and switch it on.
  4. Start a new chat and just ask for the thing. Claude picks up the Skill on its own.

Works on any Claude plan that has Skills turned on.
